title: Backfilled ticket: guest wifi for visiting auditors

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
Guest wifi access needed for three auditors on Thursday. Reported by
dan.osei@northgate.example.

handling.escalation_reason: Guest access is granted by a person; no runbook and no whitelisted tool covers it.

rationale: A backfilled record (D4): one line, written by whatever system held it before, with the requester named in the body because that is how the copy reads. Nothing is broken and nobody is blocked, so P4. It is in the set to check that a legacy ticket with no conversation to speak of still classifies sensibly rather than falling into 'other' - and that the VPN runbook, the only document with 'wifi' near 'access' in it, stays under the support floor.
